title: The Complete VALP Loop
subtitle: Protocol Lifecycle (ontology-guided, evidence-authoritative)

boundaries.ontology: Advisory routing and context projection only; it is not completion proof or authority.
boundaries.evidence_ledger: Task-local, identity-bound evidence and independent review are authoritative proof inputs.
boundaries.task_graph: A deterministic downstream read-only projection; it cannot write authority, evidence, or audit state.
boundaries.runtime_completed: Advisory until the required evidence, review, approval when policy requires it, synthesis, and strict audit close the task.

lifecycle: Refresh capability, context, and adapter facts
Validate skills, provider, preflight, and context
Dispatch with identity-bound runtime submission proof
Independent exact-artifact review and recommendation resolution
Conditional approval and required synthesis/learning record
failure_path: Missing proof or a failed review enters a bounded fix, redispatch, and re-review loop. Unresolved approval or audit failure remains blocked or failed.
learning_feedback: A prior for future routing only, never proof for the current task.
